summary.en-US: Keep one Firefox network identity consistent: proxy, public IP, approximate location, timezone, and WebRTC.

version.approval_notes: Version 1.1.1 reviewer notes are in docs/AMO-REVIEW.md in the uploaded source archive. The extension is Firefox-only. Proxy passwords stay in storage.session. A fresh install exposes virtual Direct but does not activate it or contact a GeoIP service. Direct routing works before optional GeoIP consent. Schema 2 migrates version-1 profiles without persisting the reserved virtual Direct route. GeoIP, geolocation, timezone and WebRTC policies are independent. Save changes only stored configuration; Apply atomically activates the saved revision. Session snapshots preserve the applied revision and credentials across event-page suspension. Duplicate never copies passwords. The local coordinate picker sends no tile requests and works offline. The exact signed XPI is published on GitHub only after Mozilla unlisted signing, AMO hash verification and normal Firefox signature verification. This is self-distribution, not public listing approval. No custom update URL is configured; GitHub does not automatically update installations. Existing listed submissions are preserved. Privacy details for 1.1.1 are in docs/PRIVACY.md; no external tile provider is enabled.
